native_region: MXFP4 reconstruction, qualified BF16 denoiser regions, exact native attention, fused normalization, and a precision schedule (int8 GEMMs with int8-QK/fp8-PV attention on denoising steps 8-40)

quality_scope: The checkpoint's original eight-prompt quantization screen measured loss against BF16. The optimization separately passed a bounded seven-pair screen against the identical balanced checkpoint; no arbitrary-prompt quality-equivalence claim.
performance_scope: v1.0.2: default profile schedule-int8 measured 103.637 s warm / 115.375 s first request versus 136.652 / 148.500 s for the bit-exact profile (two alternating fresh-process pairs, fixed 2048/40/CFG1 seed-42 neon workload). The bit-exact profile measured 136.285 s warm versus 165.588 s for v1.0.1 (three matched pairs, denoiser tensors bit-exact). Container repeat of the published image: 103.290 s warm / 113.950 s first (default, n=3), 133.740 / 147.830 s (exact, n=1); first seed 42, warm seed 43.
memory_scope: 25.874 GiB maximum independently sampled whole-device use in the v1.0.2 matched pairs; 25.550 GiB in the container repeat; resident components, no CPU offload or VAE tiling. Sampling can miss shorter transients.

native_fusions_option: Enabled by the managed launchers; --no-native-fusions selects the unpack-only fallback

precision_profiles.exact: Every step bit-exact against the pinned BF16 framework arithmetic, with the wave64 exact native attention and fused normalization.
precision_profiles.exact_w32: As exact, with the v1.0.1 wave32 exact attention kernel.
precision_profiles.schedule_int8: Cached text prefix and the first seven denoising steps exact; steps 8-40 with int8 activations (per 256-element block scales from the fused LayerNorm quantizer, exact-weight int8 reconstruction of the unchanged MXFP4 checkpoint) through wave64 int8 WMMA GEMMs and int8-QK / fp8-PV attention. Graded 41.8 dB PSNR / 0.0008 LPIPS at 2048x2048 and 50.2 dB at 1024x1024 against the exact images.
precision_profiles.schedule_int8_11: Ten exact denoising steps and int8-QK attention with bf16 P.V (more headroom: 42.1 dB at 2048x2048; 112.7 s warm).
precision_profiles.schedule_fp8: The eleven-forward schedule with bit-exact fp8 weights and fp8 per-row activations (slower GEMMs; 44.6 dB).

native_attention_scope: Released in v1.0.2 as the exact profile: warm complete-request median 136.285 s versus 165.588 s for v1.0.1 (17.70% lower), first request 147.428 s versus 176.981 s, three alternating fresh-process pairs; denoiser tensors bit-exact.
precision_schedule_scope: Default profile: 103.637 s warm (24.2% below the bit-exact profile) with 41.8 dB PSNR / 0.0008 LPIPS at 2048x2048 and 50.2 dB at 1024x1024 against the exact images; mode suite 50.2 / 35.0 / 52.0 / 50.2 / 48.9 dB, A-B-A repeat identical: True. Bounded graded checks on the documented prompts; no arbitrary-prompt equivalence claim. Checkpoint bytes unchanged.
